name: xiangqi-blunders-v1
metric: avoid: the engine plays a move other than `played`; better: the judge no longer rates the new move an error (same definitions). `judge_move` is one good move, not the only one.
definitions: p = 1/(1+exp(-cp/600)); clear blunder p_before >= 0.30 and p_after <= p_before - 0.30; mistake p_before >= 0.20 and loss >= 0.15
split_rule: held-out when sha256(game id)[0] % 4 == 0; never cross a game (the two games of one opening pair can fall on different sides)
